admission.justification: The attributed source owners must agree on the same selection, receipt and identity contract; a single location cannot preserve the obligation across its public producer and consumers.

applicability: A new message turn addressed to a completed task-bound Investigator.
conditions: Selection admission precedes native send or closed-session resume.
Running state is persisted under the same selection lock before admission releases.
exclusions: Steering an already open request and exact-request replay reuse their existing slot.
Projects messages retain their existing behavior.

evidence: A02.python.txt; InvestigatorTests.test_message_new_turn_obeys_capacity_before_delivery_and_resume; four sprint/master × idle/closed operation traces and persisted receipt counts

statement: A completed task-bound Investigator needs a free selection slot before a new message turn is delivered or its closed session is resumed; steering an already open request and exact-request replay reuse their slot.
